summary: Tested Phase 3 Manager Events Analytics module. All 6 backend endpoints working correctly (14/14 tests passed). Frontend 'По событиям' tab renders ManagerEventsAnalytics component with manager table, sync button, date filters, and settings subtab with checkboxes and weight inputs.
seed_data_creation: None - tested with empty data (no events synced, expected behavior)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Manager Events Analytics (Phase 3) fully implemented. Key test IDs: data-testid='tab-events' (events tab button), data-testid='event-analytics' (events analytics container), data-testid='event-managers-table' (manager table), data-testid='event-settings' (settings form), data-testid='event-tab-managers' and data-testid='event-tab-settings' (subtabs within events). Data will be empty until amoCRM sync is run. All 6 main tabs in Lead Analytics page working: Сводка, По менеджерам, Проблемные, По событиям, AI-рекомендации, Настройки.

features_tested.backend_get_event_settings: PASS - GET /api/lead-analytics/events/settings returns default settings with usefulEventTypes, weights, thresholds
features_tested.backend_put_event_settings: PASS - PUT /api/lead-analytics/events/settings saves and persists settings
features_tested.backend_get_manager_stats: PASS - GET /api/lead-analytics/events/manager-stats returns managers list with sync_id
features_tested.backend_get_event_feed: PASS - GET /api/lead-analytics/events/event-feed returns events list with filters support
features_tested.backend_get_manager_detail: PASS - GET /api/lead-analytics/events/manager-detail/{user_id} returns detail data with events, problemLeads, etc.
features_tested.backend_existing_endpoints: PASS - All existing lead-analytics endpoints still working (settings, summary, managers, problem-leads, sync-status)
features_tested.frontend_tab_events_visible: PASS - 'По событиям' tab visible in Lead Analytics page
features_tested.frontend_manager_table_or_empty: PASS - Shows empty state message when no data synced
features_tested.frontend_date_filters: PASS - Date filter inputs present (4 inputs total)
features_tested.frontend_settings_subtab: PASS - Settings subtab inside events clickable
features_tested.frontend_event_settings_form: PASS - Event settings form with checkboxes (10) and number inputs (7)
features_tested.frontend_all_tabs_clickable: PASS - All 6 main tabs (Сводка, По менеджерам, Проблемные, По событиям, AI-рекомендации, Настройки) clickable

api_endpoints_verified.GET /api/lead-analytics/events/settings: Returns default settings with usefulEventTypes, progressStageIds, successStageIds, slaFirstActionHours, stalledThresholdHours, weights
api_endpoints_verified.GET /api/lead-analytics/events/event-fee: Returns {events: [], total: int} with filter support (manager_id, event_type, date_from, date_to, limit, skip)
api_endpoints_verified.GET /api/lead-analytics/events/manager-d: Returns {stats, events, totalEvents, problemLeads, noFirstAction, noProgress, longIdle}
api_endpoints_verified.POST /api/lead-analytics/events/sync: Starts background sync, returns {status: 'started', sync_id: string}

data_testids_verified.tab-events: Events tab button in Lead Analytics page

navigation_path: Login > Click 'Sauna' card > Click 'Kontrola leadów' tab in header > Click 'По событиям' tab
notes: amoCRM integration is real but requires domain/token configured. Endpoints work but return empty data if amoCRM not configured. Event settings include 10 event type checkboxes and 7 number inputs for thresholds and weights.
